Getting Started with Widgets

Introduction

Widgets are small reusable pieces of an interface. This guide shows how to create one and place it on a page.

Installation

Install the package with the npm install widgetkit command. Then import the Widget class into your project.

npm install widgetkit
npm run build

Usage

Create a widget by calling new Widget(options) and mounting it to an element. The options object controls its size and title.

const w = new Widget({ title: "Hello", size: "small" });
w.mount(document.body);

Call w.destroy() when you no longer need the widget.
